factory_new_computer_trigger.description: Runs for each new computer in Factory. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. One deleted and later restored can start it again. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

factory_new_environment_trigger.description: Runs for each new environment in Factory. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. One deleted and later restored can start it again. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

factory_new_session_trigger.description: Runs for each new session in Factory. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. One deleted and later restored can start it again. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
